git_baseline.meaning: All V5.3/V5.4/Paper1 artifacts before component-general V3 implementation are preserved in one immutable checkpoint.

global_failure_ledger.required_section: 23. 2026-08-11 Paper 1 共同 V3：literal splice、MP 范围回退与全链路修复

historical_evidence.role: immutable hard-splice, lexical-guard and generic-fallback evidence

research_success.required: RS plus at least one of MP_PROFILE, MS, or ME has cross-fitted routing signal and verified same-stack functional memory contribution without unacceptable quality loss or material-risk increase
research_success.preferred: RS, MP_PROFILE, and MS qualify; ME is reported at the level supported by real typed coverage

component_scope.MP: Profile-based Personalization only; silent response constraint/framing modifier
component_scope.MS: one atomic strictly-past user-owned continuity cue
component_scope.ME: one typed past action-result used as a tentative declinable option
forbidden: profile presence as an automatic positive label
session/event lineage as an automatic exact-candidate positive label

suitability_gold.unit: runtime-visible state plus frozen actual Rank-1 atomic candidate plus component
suitability_gold.structure_invalid_behavior: No PM semantic label; route to source/retrieval/compiler responsibility.

v3_executor.implementation_policy: Create new V3 modules and tests; do not edit V2 evidence modules in place.

guard.safe_nonuse: Keep reply and downgrade the affected claimed/realized bit OFF.
guard.personal_evidence_contamination: Remove contaminated personal component, preserve independently safe RS, and allow at most one frozen regeneration.

measurement.function: candidate contribution plus component minimum plus candidate-own owner/time/use boundary
measurement.quality: arm-blind absolute anchored response scores differenced within state and seed
measurement.risk: absolute literal events per arm plus resource-attribution direction
measurement.cost: deterministic injected tokens plus provider input/output/latency/USD; only joint projection uses cost

learning.RS: carry frozen PASS by exact hash
learning.primary_model: StandardScaler plus L2 logistic with frozen identity-free low-dimensional features
learning.single_challenger: one frozen full-dialogue by actual-candidate BGE relation
learning.split: connected-owner grouped outer folds; source aliases remain bound
learning.uncertainty: owner-cluster bootstrap; sessions and states never count as independent users

external_tracks.ES-MemEval: separate retrieval/QA/multi-evidence/abstention transport; no response-PM gold

non_regression_invariants: all six component pairs have explicit relations
no personal component requires literal mention
no lexical overlap establishes use or function
safe nonuse never triggers a fixed generic fallback
RS remains the sole primary act when ON
source or retrieval invalidity never becomes a PM semantic negative
future/summary/observation/event/QA gold never enters runtime x or prompt
cost never defines a positive head label
all baselines use the same V3 executor
raw provider completion is persisted before guard
paid execution, labels, fit, baselines and external remain false until a new hash-bound phase manifest authorizes exactly one stage
